svg.title: .com Pricing Across Dedicated Registrars
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-com-registrar-pricing; chapter number: 2; title: .com Pricing Across Dedicated Registrars; subtitle: Price every name on its renewal rate, not first-year bait; chart type: horizontal_bars; unit: USD per .com year; bars: label: Spaceship; min: 8.88; max: 9.98; typical: 9.98; display: $8.88 register, $9.98 renew; label: Cloudflare Registrar; min: 10.46; max: 11.17; typical: 11.17; display: $11.17 at cost; $10.46 in Utke's cart; label: Dynadot; min: 10.88; max: 10.88; typical: 10.88; display: $10.88; label: Porkbun; min: 11.81; max: 11.81; typical: 11.81; display: About $11.81 flat, register and renew; label: Bait-Priced Host Offer; min: 0.01; max: 40.0; typical: 40.0; display: 1 cent advertised, $40 charged; caption: The cheapest published .com figures sit within about three dollars of each other, while a 1-cent host offer that secretly charges $40 shows why renewal price decides.; assumptions note: Typical values use the renewal or at-cost figure where a register-versus-renew split was reported; prices are as quoted by each practitioner at recording time.; note: Sources Design Guy (mMGvtO-bkPI @ 00:00:59), SEARCHLIGHT HQ (RClpPcLHviU @ 00:00:30), David Utke (UkMYRY9wDN0 @ 00:10:42), Create a Pro Website (08Ekqe45IH0 @ 00:00:14).

text.title: Assumptions: Typical values use the renewal or at-cost figure where a register-versus-renew split was reported; prices are as quoted by each practitioner at recording time.
